svg.title: R82 prespecified conditional missing-gaze probabilities
svg.desc: Two analytic plots for predictor magnitudes zero and four at time .5 and trial index zero. MCAR is horizontal 12 percent; MAR depends only on recorded predictor time trial; MNAR additionally uses unobserved true outcome residual through logistic plus 1.1 tanh residual divided by .08. These are simulation-law probabilities, not estimated sensor missingness.
svg.text: Analytic probabilities at trial 0 and normalized time t=0.50 · not estimated from a gaze recording
